title: Better Toggle Sneak
description: The toggle sneak option is bad... So i made it 100 times better!
body:
This mod upgrades toggle sneak by giving it its own keybind for full control.

Toggle sneak on using the mod key, then toggle it off using either the same key or the default sneak key. This makes movement feel natural and prevents getting stuck sneaking.

Default keybind: `V`
You can change the keybind anytime in the Minecraft controls settings.

Clean, simple, and much better than normal toggle sneak.
